notes: Mint-family perennial, hardy to zone 4. Self-seeds aggressively; cut back before bloom to control spread.
harvestIndicators: Stems 6 to 10 inches before bloom, strong lemon scent

careTasks.title: To prevent spreading, prune flowering stalks before they have a chance to set seed.
Stems can be cut as needed anytime during the season preferably before flowering.

seasonalTasks.title: Cut back lemon balm
seasonalTasks.body: Cut the plants back to about half their height for fresh new growth, then water to help them recover.

seasonalTasks.title: Thin lemon balm in mid-summer
seasonalTasks.body: Cut out some stems to let air through, and cut off flower stalks before they set seed.
